W.note: Slim pill that opens to a rich multi-package timeline with good ARIA, but the package tabs are clipped, the title wraps awkwardly and the actions wrap into a second row.

X.note: Polished icon toast with progress bar, five-step stepper, timeline, carrier and number, pager dots and labeled actions; clear chevron state, aria-expanded and live region, with a slightly clipped subtitle when open.

Y.note: Pill is neat and has a T shortcut, but the open timeline is misaligned with right-aligned events and times stranded under dots, leaving dead space and weak hierarchy.

Z.note: Clean, tidy toast with progress bar, ETA and timeline, but the UPS/USPS/FedEx tabs are confusing, the number is minimal and there is a bit of empty space at the bottom.
